title: Pinned pass
description: A numbered athletics pass swings from a constrained cord and keeps its weight when released.
useCase: Add direct manipulation to a small event credential or collectible.
reducedMotion: The pass follows deliberate input without inertial playback; arrow keys place it immediately.
limitations: A two-dimensional constrained cord and rigid card with approximate rotation; no cloth, collision or metal shading engine.
look: Bright red field with a dark cord hanging from a top rail to a cream event badge with grommet, huge condensed numeral and barcode stripes.
motion: A nine-point Verlet cord with gravity and damping swings the badge, which tilts with the last segment (±42°); dragging pins the cord's end, and release lets it sway to rest.
adapt: Physics is `simulate`: Verlet integration (0.973 damping, 0.22 gravity) and 12 constraint passes over nine `knots`, stepped at 60 Hz by `frame` for 220 steps after release; `draw` maps the last segment to the card's rotation. Replace the `.pp-inner` badge content.
